content: हर्षण {%a.%} (-णा|-णी|{%f.%}) [हृष्-णिच् ल्यु] .²1 Causing delight, gladdening, delightful, pleasant. .²2 Causing the hair of the body to stand erect; संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् <ls>Bg. 18. 74</ls>. .{@-णः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the five arrows of Kāmadeva. .²2 A morbid affection of the eyes. .²3 A deity presiding over the funeral ceremonies. .²4 A funeral and other rites; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²5 One of the 27 yogas (<ab>Astr.</ab>); <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-णम्@} .²1 Joy, delight, happiness, gladdening, delighting; दुर्हृदामप्रहर्षाय सुहृदां हर्षणाय च <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 Raising the spirit (of an army); खातकव्यूहतत्त्वज्ञं बलहर्षणकोविदम् <ls>Mb. 12. 118. 11</ls>. .²3 Erection of the sexual organ, sexual excitement.
